name: Single-piece geometric control
content: Calculate ONLY the geometric controls of the selected piece from the CURRENT board (FEN, ASCII board and inventory), NOT a remembered opening. Return JSON with EXACTLY two fields: "controls" and "xray". Pawn controls are forward diagonals (not forward moves); knights jump; kings control neighboring squares regardless of check. Rooks, bishops and queens control each ray up to and INCLUDING the first occupied square, whether friendly or enemy. List controlled squares once in lexicographic order. Then, for R/B/Q only, inspect each legal ray with a blocker. Write "xray" as an array of {"direction":"S","first":"d5","second":"d1"}: first is the SQUARE of the first occupied piece, second is the SQUARE of the next occupied piece further on the SAME ray. If no second piece exists, use null. DO NOT emit piece names or IDs in first/second: write only lowercase algebraic coordinates like "d5", NEVER "wN_d5", "bP_d5", "N_d5" or "p_d5". Record blockers of BOTH colors, even your own. A ray with no first blocker has no xray record. R/B/Q ray directions are N,NE,E,SE,S,SW,W,NW; non-sliders P/N/K must return "xray":[]; no xray claim is a legal capture. Sort xray records by direction. You may briefly explain before the final result, but finish with ONE JSON object, optionally in a markdown json fence, and nothing after it. Format example: {"controls":["a5","b6","c7","c8","d5","d6","d7","e7","e8"],"xray":[{"direction":"S","first":"d5","second":"d1"}]}. This example is schematic: calculate ALL controls and ALL xray directions for the actual selected piece; do NOT copy the example blindly. No extra fields.
